questions.question: What does God call the people to do in Joel 2?
options: Offer up a full thousand bulls and rams upon the temple altar of the LORD
Gather a great army together at once to drive out the cruel invading foe
Flee away to the safety of the far high mountains before the locusts ever once come
Return to him with all their heart, rending their hearts and not their garments
questions.answer: Return to him with all their heart, rending their hearts and not their garments

questions.question: What famous promise about the Spirit appears in Joel 2?
options: 'I will raise up a king from David's line'
'I will scatter you among the nations'
'I will send a famine over all the land'
'I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh'
questions.answer: 'I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh'

questions.question: Joel 2 says everyone who calls on the name of the LORD shall be saved.
Rend your _____ and not your garments. Return to the LORD your God.
I will pour out my _____ on all flesh; your sons and daughters shall prophesy.
